summary: Profile/Open/Public Profile audit after eee702a8 and local audit e1d57653. The main entry still statically reaches the large profile open-flow module through app-controller-bridge.js. That module is not used to render the initial /feed surface; it is used when a profile/business/user route or user action opens a profile. A cached dynamic import trial of profile-open-flow-utils.js was safe at source level, but the measured built entry reduction was only 6,965 bytes gzip, below the requested around-10-KB target. The trial implementation was reverted and this pass stops after the audit.
